definitions.explanation: A type or format that emphasizes direct participation and personal experience rather than passive observation. Common in tourism, education, and marketing to describe activities where participants engage actively.

examples.japanese: {体験型|たいけんがた}の{観光|かんこう}が{人気|にんき}だ。
{子供|こども}{向|む}けの{体験型|たいけんがた}{施設|しせつ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Interactive facilities for children are increasing.

examples.japanese: この{博物館|はくぶつかん}は{体験型|たいけんがた}の{展示|てんじ}が{多|おお}く、{実際|じっさい}に{触|さわ}ったり{操作|そうさ}したりできる。
examples.english: This museum has many interactive exhibits where you can actually touch and operate things.

notes:
USAGE:
A pre-noun modifier using the pattern ～{型|がた} (type/style). Part of a productive word-formation pattern where {型|がた} indicates a category: {参加型|さんかがた} (participatory), {対話型|たいわがた} (interactive/dialogue-based). Frequently used in tourism marketing and education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体験型|たいけんがた}{観光|かんこう} (experiential tourism)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}{学習|がくしゅう} (experiential learning)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}{施設|しせつ} (hands-on facility)
- {体験型|たいけんがた}イベント (interactive event)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {参加型|さんかがた}: participatory — emphasizes active participation
- {体験|たいけん}: experience — the base noun meaning a direct personal experience
